unit.why: One narrative: R. Berish visits his rival R. Avish in Vishnitsa. Their exchange about having a single rebbe and the order of 'lechaim' and blessing is set within the encounter, which forms the story.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the series of R. Berish anecdotes from the previous division ('אף גם זאת'), but stands as a separate episode.

stories.start_quote: אף גם זאת בהיות הרב ר׳ בעריש בווישניצא
stories.summary_en: In Vishnitsa R. Berish visits his rival R. Avish, who confesses that a trip to Lublin cost him his Rymanov master's favour. R. Berish explains that every tzaddik interprets another and that one goes to others only with one's rebbe's permission. He then justifies saying 'lechaim' before the blessing on brandy, because love of Israel precedes love of God.

tags.why: The whole story is an encounter between two Hasidic leaders and their circles.
